thought: This is an establishing shot focused on the setting itself - Wolf Fang Mountain during wartime 1941. The prompt emphasizes the dangerous, desolate terrain characteristics: jagged peaks, precipitous cliffs, rugged paths. Given the visual style requirements (realistic thick-painted 2D animation with strong chiaroscuro and low-saturation earth tones), I'm incorporating dramatic lighting and specific color palette instructions. Since the model struggles with layout, I'm being explicit about spatial arrangement of terrain elements. The photographic approach uses techniques that emphasize scale, danger, and epic atmosphere.
prompt: Wide establishing shot, Wolf Fang Mountain wartime landscape, autumn 1941. Exposure: ISO 200, f/8, natural overcast daylight, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with strong light-dark contrast. Composition: Low-angle perspective looking upward, emphasizing verticality and danger, rule of thirds with jagged peaks occupying upper two-thirds, leading lines from rugged mountain paths drawing eye toward precipitous summit. Depth of Field: Deep, rendering entire mountainscape in sharp focus from foreground rocky terrain to distant peaks. Lens: 24mm wide-angle lens for epic scale and environmental context. Genre: Landscape photography, historical environmental documentary. Style: Realistic thick-painted 2D animation aesthetic, low-saturation earth-tone color palette, somber and heavy atmosphere. Setting Details: Steep, rugged mountain terrain with jagged peaks resembling interlocking dog teeth silhouetted against grey sky, three sides featuring sheer cliff faces and precipitous drops of thousands of feet, complex topography with winding treacherous mountain paths, exposed rock walls, deep canyons and ravines. Color Palette: Desaturated withered yellow and earth yellow tones dominating rocky surfaces, grey-brown stone, muted ochre and sienna in sparse vegetation, cool grey overcast sky. Lighting Quality: Diffused natural light filtered through war-time haze, creating stark shadows in crevices and valleys, rim lighting along cliff edges emphasizing dangerous drops. Atmosphere: Desolate, harsh, grave, emphasizing extreme danger and wartime severity. Texture: Rough, craggy rock surfaces, weathered stone, sparse dried autumn grass. No characters present, pure environmental shot showcasing the treacherous battlefield terrain.
